scope: Non-RPG cooperative puzzles and communication, using Take Time and The Crew Mission Deep Sea as reference points

selection.policy: Filter by shared team objective and non-RPG puzzle/communication fit first, then prioritize BGG Overall rank. Lower-ranked close mechanisms are explicitly retained as supplements.
criteria: No adversarial teams, traitors, or individual victory goals
Prioritize hidden information, restricted communication, distributed actions
Exclude campaign/progression/dungeon-combat focus from the primary pool
Preserve score-based and real-time official semantics

ranking.retrieval: Recent search-indexed original BGG pages; different crawl dates, not live API
ranking.caveat: Games are sorted by observed rank, not implementation priority. Lower-ranked games are not described as top-ranked.

The server records actual arrival order. This adapter does not impose a seconds-per-number policy or fabricate thinking delays.
Request latency and polling can affect performance. This runtime is not certified equivalent to physical human timing.
success verifies level completion; it does not prove agents avoided mental counting or out-of-band signals.
